name: 53208 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53208 (Milwaukee) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 52 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53208 (Milwaukee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53208 (Milwaukee) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
